title: PowerPoint for Mac: modernised Presenter View with a single control bar
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts match, and the updated November 24 release notes still do not announce the Presenter View redesign. The default and feature-specific control gaps remain unfilled. Minor corrections are needed for an uncited update-deployment source and checklist advice about a control missing from the table.
